---
title: Deploy your own
description: The Vercel-first deploy recipes — the gtm-docs app in one click or via the guided script, and workflow scenario apps with their environment wiring and SAMPLE_DATA demo mode.
---

Two things in this repo deploy, and both are Vercel-first: the **gtm-docs app**
you are reading — deployable today — and the **workflow scenario apps** under
`workflows/`, which land with paydirt **0.5.0**. This page is the recipe for
each.

## Deploy the gtm-docs app

What you get is a **read-only docs instance**: every board and document renders
for your team, while the writable studio stays local — clone the repo,
`pnpm dev`, edit, push. No credentials are required; the content ships inside
the build.

**One click** — the repo README's Deploy Button clones the repo with
`apps/gtm-docs` as the root directory and opens it on Vercel:

[![Deploy with Vercel](https://vercel.com/button)](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fnika-loki%2Fpaydirt&root-directory=apps%2Fgtm-docs)

**Guided, from a clone:**

```bash
pnpm --filter gtm-docs exec node scripts/deploy.mjs
```

The script hand-holds five steps: it checks the Vercel CLI exists and you are
logged in, confirms the project name and links `apps/gtm-docs` to it, offers to
set environment variables (none are required for this read-only deploy; any
value you enter is read with echo disabled and piped straight to the CLI —
never printed), runs `vercel deploy --prod`, then verifies the live URL answers
on `/docs` before declaring success. The only outbound request it makes is that
final verification, and only to the public https URL the CLI just returned.

Deployed instances are read-only by design — the studio's save path exists
only in local development. To edit boards, clone the repo and run
`pnpm --filter gtm-docs dev`; changes reach your deployment on the next deploy.

## Deploy a workflow app

Workflow packages (`workflows/hubspot-clay-sync/`, `workflows/crm-hygiene/` —
both landing with paydirt 0.5.0) are independently deployable apps —
Vercel-first, Render acceptable when durable-workflow semantics aren't needed.
The
[workflow template](/docs/build/workflow-template) is the MUST list every
package satisfies; this is the deploy path around it.

1. **Wire the environment variables** — each system record lists its keys as
   **names only** (`HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `CLAY_API_KEY`, `CRON_SECRET`,
   `DRY_RUN`, …); values live with the secrets owner, and every example value
   in the repo is the literal `replace-me`. Set them per environment in your
   deployment platform, never in the repo.
2. **Map the environment ladder to deployment targets** — development runs
   locally (`pnpm dev`), pilot runs on a preview deployment with manual
   triggers, production runs on the production deployment on a cron schedule.
   The [promotion guide](/docs/build/promotion) covers the gates, the dispatch
   contract, and rollback; [secrets](/docs/build/secrets) covers the local
   `.env.*` lifecycle and names-only sync.
3. **Pick demo mode if you want a public instance** — `SAMPLE_DATA=true`
   swaps live credentials for a bundled sample dataset and nothing else
   changes: zero credentials present, public read-only, rate-limited. The
   `crm-hygiene` record documents this `demo` blast-radius class in detail.

<Callout type="info" title="In short">

gtm-docs deploys with no environment variables at all — the content ships
inside the build. Workflow apps need their keys wired per environment; names
live in each system record, values never touch the repo. `SAMPLE_DATA=true` is
the zero-credential demo mode for public deployments.

</Callout>
